steps.name: Treasure Hunt (1)
steps.objective: First, talk to [Io] in “Gerda” and defeat [Argos] in “Icicle Prison” to obtain <Mint Chocolate Icicle Shaved Ice>. Then report the quest to [Adkina] in the “Flaming Wheel.”

lines.text: (Io is sitting on a bench on one side of Gerda Village with a blank expression.)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Why are you doing this, Io?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I have nothing to do... .

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Haven't you been busy since morning? As if cleaning the house wasn't enough, I also cleaned the village, did laundry, played with the village children, exercised, and ate meals.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: It's only been three hours and there's nothing to do? Just relax without thinking about anything.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I’m bored… .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I guess it's because I no longer have anything to do since I no longer do the things I used to do.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I’m bored… .

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: I'm not like that older sister who is bored and doing nothing, but I'm a little embarrassed to hear something like that coming out of your mouth.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: That's right. I guess it's been a while since I've felt this way since I've been working without a break for hundreds of years.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: A guest is coming just now.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Oh, is it %s? %s, %s! It's here!

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: %s, I've been waiting for you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Were you waiting for me?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: What should I do when Io sings that she is bored?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can't believe Io said she was bored. Not even Shinik… .

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: That's right. Hmm… . We've been together for hundreds of years, and I've never seen Io this bored.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: … Hey, do you want to go visit Adkina?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Even the Valley of the Dragon?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: No, you're in the burning wheel now. Since it is close to the snowy field, you can also go to Narin.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Okay, let's go together.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you are on a cart, it must be in its original form.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Yes, that's right. Adkina must have used a lot of energy and was hungry. So, I decided to take some food that would satisfy my appetite.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that's nice. Can I go to Seolhwa?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: No, it's in the icicle prison. I built a separate freezer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's food there?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Oh my, is it really ‘that’?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Yes, it's food made following the Freios trend. Gallet helped me.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Well then, shall we go?
(Narin looks at the food in Io and %s's hands and is speechless.)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Hey, how did you get into this?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: As a spirit myself, I know that there will definitely be likes and dislikes about this. How about %s?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: This ‘Mint Chocolate Icicle Shaved Ice’… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… , I think I will eat it if I have it and not eat it if I don’t have it.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: … Is that it?
(Io looks at Bingsu and Narin alternately with an expression of complete ignorance.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Surprisingly, Adkina might like it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, I don't know. Hehe, shall we go first?

steps.name: Treasure hunt (2)
steps.objective: Defeat [Echo] in “Fountain of Echoes” to obtain <Blue Scale of the Ancient Pluton Dragon>. Then report the quest to [Adkina] in the “Flaming Wheel.”

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Hmm, I'm hungry.
(Dragon Adkina quietly strokes his stomach with his hand, or rather his front paw.)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Strangely, I feel empty inside the cart. Oh, is it Io?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Adkina, you are here.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I came back because I was worried about the empty cart wheel. Oh, you're here too. It's only been a few days, but it's nice to see you again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Adkina. Nice to meet you too.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Oh, you… It's a spirit. No, the spirit king.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: I'm late to say hello to you, Adkina, as I've been away from you. My name is Narin.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I heard that he is the spirit king of water and ice. Thank you for protecting Io all this time. I wish you all the best in the future.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Io is a child with a quirky side, so I'm just grateful that you care so much about her.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: He talks about all sorts of things. Adkina, you seem to be very hungry, so I prepared some delicacies for you.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: It's a delicacy, I'm looking forward to it.
(Adkina is momentarily speechless when he sees the mint chocolate icicle shaved ice prepared by Io.)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Io, thank you for your sincerity in preparing... . Okay, you can't ignore sincerity, so I'll take a bite... .
(Adkina raises her head and roars into the empty space of the cart.)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Adkina… ?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I almost said something harsh. Io, next time you come, give me some meat just like you gave it to Baldrick... .

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Hey, Adkina seems very angry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … It's the first time I've seen you get so angry.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Don't be too angry.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I'm sorry. You prepared it like this, but this old man complained about the food, right? I didn't know I would stay like this for this long.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I understand. I'm feeling strange these days too. I'm bored, perhaps because the work I've been doing for a long time has disappeared.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Hey, are you just as bored to death as Shineek?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I don't know. It somehow feels like a hollow ice box. As if it would melt any moment... .

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Hey, can I fill it for you?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I wonder if I don’t know what’s inside you. He said he was going to hold him and give him lots of water. Do you like giving your friend water that much?
(Narin chuckles at Io's reaction and then discovers something near Adkina's waist.)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Uh, Adkina. There is a spot where scales have fallen off. Are you okay? Are you feeling unwell or something... .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I guess a few of them fell off while I was exerting myself inside the wheel. It seemed to have flown towards the Well of Echoes.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: It worked out just fine. Hey, won't you find it for me? Treasure hunt… If you think… .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Treasure hunt… .
(Io suddenly gets lost in thought and grabs %s’s hand.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Adkina, I’ll be back. %s, let's go together. For some reason, I feel like I'll find it right away if I'm here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Suddenly? uh?
(At that time, the voice of the dragon Adkina flows into %s's head.)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: 「… Please come with me for Io’s sake.”
(Adkina nods quietly as if to say something.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then… Hey, shall we go together?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Thank you, %s.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Narin will keep me company while you return to the Well of Echoes.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Are you okay with me?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Of course it's okay. If you're going to become new friends, any conversation will be fun.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Then, Adkina, please take care of our Narin. Now, go to the spring to find treasure!
(Io holds %s's hand and exits the cart, turning his head to look at Narin.)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Ah, Narin, Gaia had something to tell you.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Yes? Are you talking about the goddess? What did you say?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: He said he was fortunate to have you who froze Deborah, a part of the continent that almost burned down, and saved many lives... . and… .
(Io and %s, who were wandering through the Well of Echoes, see something shining blue between the ice and snow.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I found it!

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: It's definitely Adkina's scale. I thought it would take a long time to find it, but I'm glad I found it early.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Adkina sent me here on purpose.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What does that mean?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: When was it, long ago, so long ago, so long ago that I can't even remember... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: There was a time when I played in the snow with my parents. It's not a big deal, but if you hide small items like this, I'll find them.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: It's like looking for treasure. There were times when I went in quite late looking for something like that. But my parents didn't scold me... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Ionis, you are a child who perseveres in finding everything. Even if things get difficult later, never give up, just do it like you are now... . You said this… .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Well, Adkina must have had a connection with my parents. I see that you deliberately sent me to go on a treasure hunt. Hehe… .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: It was fun. I wasn't bored.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How are you feeling?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Very good. Hehehe. I think I went for a light walk.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's a relief.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I haven't done anything in particular... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: %s Your very existence is a gift to us. Hehe… . I'm sure I'm not the only one who thinks that way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's too much praise.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Hehe, it's okay no matter how you take it. And it’s okay for me to live a little more leisurely now, right?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Of course I'll do what I have to do. Just because the ice melts in front of your eyes doesn't mean you'll get warm right away.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Let's go now. Adkina will be waiting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, shall we go then?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Oh, are you guys here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I’ve been there!

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Adkina, I’m back! Narin waited a long time too, right?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: I had a nice chat with Adkina.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What did you two talk about?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: We talked about the essence of beauty.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it perhaps about the discernment to distinguish between cuteness and beauty? What Beled said… .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: It's similar, but a little different. Ancient gods and spirits... , talked about life at that time.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: That was interesting, Adkina. I'm glad you found my story interesting.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Narin, what did you talk about?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: I told you a story from when you were young. How different and cute it was back then... . Was there a boy you liked?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: You go to town and see you. Okay? I will make you look pretty. Hehehe.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: That's right. Hehehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha… .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Ah, I found a treasure, no, a scale.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I'm glad I found it quickly. You don't have to give it to me.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I heard people say that dragon scales bring good luck and health. This is my gift, Io.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Thank you. Adkina! It's really pretty.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: If I get a chance later, I will prepare separate gifts for %s and Narin.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay, Adkina.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Adkina, your very existence is a gift.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Thank you for saying that. This is all Gaia’s grace… .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: If it weren't for Gaia's grace, I might have become an evil being like Gluat.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (If it weren't for Iris, I might have looked different...)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: At the time, I didn't even care what story Gluart had. I found out later that he killed many people using his scales as bait.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: This is my fault... . Because I ended up ignoring it... .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: At that time, before Giscard could subdue him, he came to me and asked.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: He said he wanted to make sure that I, who follows the goddess, am different from Gluat. It's a shame that it was the same answer. If it had been a different answer, one of them wouldn't have been around by now.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Jiscard and other children who became superhumans must have been anxious about the fact that they had become different from ordinary humans at some point. You must have been left alone and lonely for a long time... .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Just like me... . Still, I'm glad. Because we can be together as friends, not enemies.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: It's all thanks to you that I have this faith. It brought everyone together.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, no. What did I do?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: If you go too far with humility, you'll get stabbed in the heart with an icicle. Let's admit what we have to admit.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Hehe, thanks to %s, many people have changed.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Yes, because you are already everyone’s treasure.
(Io and Narin smile brightly at Adkina’s words.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm embarrassed. Ahaha… .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I'm embarrassed to say something like that. Adkina, would you like to spend some more time with us?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Good. So why not keep talking?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Stories are good, but how about this?
(When Narin opens the scroll he was holding, all kinds of things fall out.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Narin, you have prepared properly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: From cards and dice to horse boards... .

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Let’s all enjoy the entertainment together. With this, you can play without even knowing the sun is setting!

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Hey, I'm an old man who doesn't know the rules, but can I join in?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: It's okay. Basically, things like this have to be done together to be fun.
(Io creates a blizzard and inserts a card into Adkina's front paw. Narin then hands out cards and explains the rules, and the game begins.)
(The burning wheel is filled with the laughter of people enjoying the game. However, it seems that it is not just one person.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, I lost again.
